text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees work faster and more efficiently. Rather than replacing people, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where workers focus on creative and complex decisions while machines manage routine jobs. Of course, these changes mean that some roles are disappearing while new ones are appearing. This is why many experts believe that learning new skills and staying flexible will be essential for success in the modern workplace.
